_comment: Drop one of these blocks into your Claude Desktop config under mcpServers. Default mode is READ-ONLY; the trigger_motor_action tool will refuse to execute even if Claude flips dry_run=False.
_mock: No hardware needed. Deterministic fake plant, good for trying the tools out.
_esp32: Talks HTTP to a real SiloScan module on your LAN. Use the absolute path to uv: Claude Desktop does not inherit your shell PATH. INDUSTRIAL_MCP_ESP32_CABLES lists the mux channels that actually have a cable on them -- the default is channel 0 only, so leaving it out silently drops every other probe.
_transport: This is MCP over stdio: Claude Desktop launches the process on your own machine and talks to it over stdin/stdout. Nothing reaches the module from outside your LAN. The module has no authentication, so do not put it behind a remote MCP transport without an authenticated gateway in front.
